objective: Prove that a parity decision tree of depth d for a CNF's false-clause search gives an F2 Nullstellensatz refutation of degree d + w (w the clause width), and that the sphere's count needs F2 Nullstellensatz degree n^{Omega(1)}, by Beame et al.'s degree bound for the sink-counting principle carried through linear substitution and the decision-tree reductions of COUNT-SYSTEMS-20261110-001A; so every tree-like Res(xor) refutation of the count has height n^{Omega(1)}.
status: Proved 2026-11-10: every parity decision tree for the sphere's count, hence every tree-like Res(xor) refutation, has depth at least c n^{1/8}/log n, because a depth-d parity tree is an F2 Nullstellensatz refutation of degree d + 3 and the count needs F2 degree Omega(n^{1/8}/log n) (Beame et al.'s sink bound through linear substitution and decision-tree reductions); size remains open.
title: Parity decision trees on the count need polynomial depth
